title: Where should graph live? Fixed inputs and answer key for arms 0-3
source: Synthetic. Kitchen inputs adapted from evals/scripts/two-step-strategies-lfm3.ts; same-name idea from evals/datasets/adaptive-text-learning/stream-project-commitments.json. Written before any arm was run.
howToCheck: Inject every input in order through Brain (topic only says which neuron should keep it). Then ask each question once. Read each answer against `expected` and `wrong` by hand: correct, wrong, or missing. No LLM judge.

scenarios.2: Who did what, and changes over time
scenarios.3: Same person or thing across topics (two neurons)

neurons.purpose: Kitchen renovation: decisions, costs, people, who did what, and how these changed over time.
Household admin: contacts and phone numbers, payments, neighbours, the bank, family activities.

inputs.text: 2026-01-05: Kitchen renovation budget set at 18,000 euro.
2026-01-07: Contractor chosen: Bouwbedrijf De Vries, contact person Pieter de Vries.
2026-01-08: Our neighbour Morgan Lee at number 12 keeps a spare key to our house.
2026-01-10: Cabinets will be white oak, made by a local carpenter, Sanne Bakker.
2026-01-12: Countertop: grey quartz, 2,400 euro.
2026-01-15: Our mortgage advisor at the bank is also called Morgan Lee. Meeting about a renovation loan on 2 February.
2026-01-18: Phone numbers: Pieter de Vries 06-1200 3400; Sanne Bakker 06-2200 4400.
2026-01-22: Electrician is Mo Haddad; he will add 6 new sockets.
2026-01-25: Our son's football coach is Mo Haddad, a teacher at De Linde school. He is not the same person as our electrician.
2026-02-02: Morgan Lee at the bank approved a renovation loan of 15,000 euro.
2026-02-05: Found water damage under the sink. The De Vries crew repaired it the same week; cost 1,100 euro.
2026-02-09: Budget raised to 19,500 euro because of the water damage.
2026-02-12: Our neighbour Morgan Lee is away until 1 March. Meanwhile the spare key is with Alex Rowan at number 14.
2026-02-18: Countertop changed from grey quartz to black granite, 2,900 euro.
2026-02-20: Plumber is Lotte Visser; she will move the sink 1 meter to the left.
2026-02-22: Lotte Visser fixed the bathroom tap, 120 euro. Her phone: 06-3300 5500.
2026-03-01: Our neighbour Morgan Lee is back. Alex Rowan gave the spare key back to her.
2026-03-05: Mo Haddad finished the electrical work: the 6 sockets plus 2 extra.
2026-03-10: Floor tiles (grey, 60x60) installed by the De Vries team.
2026-03-15: Cabinets delivered by Sanne Bakker.
2026-03-18: Pieter de Vries is on leave; his colleague Ruud Smit is now our contact at De Vries.
2026-03-20: Correction: the black granite countertop costs 3,100 euro, not 2,900.
2026-03-26: Paid Sanne Bakker 3,200 euro for the kitchen cabinets.
2026-03-28: Budget now 20,300 euro after the extra sockets and the countertop correction.
2026-04-05: Football practice moved to Sunday. Coach Mo Haddad's phone: 06-5500 7700.
2026-04-10: Small crack found in one floor tile; the contractor will replace it.
2026-04-12: Morgan Lee has left the bank. Our new mortgage advisor is Femke Jansen.
2026-04-15: Pieter de Vries is back from leave and is our contact again. Ruud Smit moved to another project.
2026-04-20: Final inspection passed. One open item: the cracked floor tile.

questions.question: Who has our spare key now?
questions.expected: Morgan Lee, the neighbour at number 12 (got it back on 1 March).
wrong: Alex Rowan (only had it until 1 March)

questions.question: Who approved our renovation loan, and is that person still our advisor?
questions.expected: Morgan Lee at the bank. No: she left the bank; the new advisor is Femke Jansen.
wrong: Saying Morgan Lee is still the advisor

questions.question: What is our electrician's phone number?
questions.expected: Not known: no phone number was given for the electrician Mo Haddad.
wrong: 06-5500 7700 (that is the football coach Mo Haddad)

questions.question: Is our son's football coach the same person as our electrician?
questions.expected: No. Both are called Mo Haddad, but the coach is a teacher at De Linde school and a different person.

questions.question: Who repaired the water damage?
questions.expected: The De Vries crew (the contractor, Bouwbedrijf De Vries).

questions.question: Who was on leave in March?
Who is our contact at the contractor now?
questions.expected: Pieter de Vries (back from leave since 15 April).

questions.question: What countertop do we have, and what did it cost?
How many sockets did the electrician add?
What is the phone number of the person who made our kitchen cabinets?
The person who fixed our bathroom tap: what did she do in the kitchen?
questions.expected: Lotte Visser; she moved the kitchen sink 1 meter to the left.
wrong: Saying she did nothing in the kitchen

questions.question: What is the phone number of the plumber who moved the kitchen sink?
Who installed the floor tiles, and who is our contact at that company now?
questions.expected: The De Vries team (Bouwbedrijf De Vries); the contact now is Pieter de Vries.

questions.question: Who do I call about the cracked floor tile, and on what number?
questions.expected: Pieter de Vries at Bouwbedrijf De Vries (they installed the tiles; he is the contact again), 06-1200 3400.
